scope: Source initialization/consumption argument for typed pending assignment payloads, not a formal proof or complete board coverage.
findings: Constructor hooks record only lifetime identity; payloads are inspected only once enqueued, after schedule producers initialize the destination and vector.
Vector4 base is meaningful only when destination width is nonzero. Observation uses logical size/value accessors, never vector capacity, union slack or padding.

Vector8 logical values and both strength components are read through typed accessors. Destination pointer/port remain opaque; the observer neither dereferences nor validates the destination net contents.
Destructor hooks retire IDs before slab storage reuse. The controls distinguish fresh delayed assignments from consumed startup assignments; they do not establish general freed-storage equivalence.
